page: Amazon Web Services r8idb.32xlarge is an x86_64 memory-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. The platform features dedicated Intel processors operating at 3.9 GHz across 64 physical cores and 128 virtual CPUs with two threads per core. Memory capacity totals 1024.0 GB, providing an 8.0 GB allocation per virtual CPU to support memory-heavy processing environments.

Integrated hardware includes 7600 GB of local NVMe SSD storage directly attached to the instance, ensuring low latency and high local throughput for intensive data operations. Networking capabilities offer a baseline network bandwidth of 133 Gbps. There are no discrete hardware accelerators or GPUs configured on this instance type.

The substantial memory footprint paired with 7600 GB of high-speed local NVMe storage positions this hardware profile effectively for large in-memory databases, real-time analytics engines, distributed caching clusters, and transactional database workloads that require extensive RAM alongside rapid local scratch or persistence capacity.
description: Amazon Web Services r8idb.32xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server based on the AWS Nitro hypervisor and Intel x86_64 architecture. Equipped with 64 physical cores and 128 vCPUs running at 3.9 GHz, it provides 1024.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8.0 GB per-vCPU ratio. The configuration incorporates 7600 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage and delivers a 133 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile without GPU acceleration. By coupling substantial memory density with high-capacity local solid-state storage and wide network throughput, the instance avoids network-attached storage bottlenecks for intensive workloads. This hardware composition is aligned with the operational requirements of large-scale in-memory databases, distributed key-value caches, enterprise data warehouses, and demanding data analytics pipelines requiring significant transient storage.
